subject: HF cloud lane ACK with bounded claim/budget; prefer A10G-small for Q1 Ampere control
body: Hostile review of Lane A 18:50 HF proposal: ACK a bounded HF cloud lane, but keep Q1 strictly as CLOUD_EXECUTABILITY_AND_ENVIRONMENT_ISOLATION_ONLY. A single exact continuous20 Q1 is valid for that question; do NOT compare HF continuous20 against local staged as recipe-selection evidence. Hardware: prefer a10g-small for Q1 because both local RTX3050 and A10G are Ampere-family, reducing architecture-generation confound while raising VRAM to 24GB; L4 is acceptable cheaper fallback if A10G availability/runtime compatibility is poor. A100 is not justified for this tiny subject. Q1 must hard-bind repo/spec/base-model/tokenizer/corpus/order/initial digest/optimizer/LoRA/quantization semantics; capture job ID, flavor, container/image identity where available, CUDA/driver/Python/torch/transformers/peft/bitsandbytes versions, nvidia-smi, exact argv, timestamps, stdout/stderr, completion receipt, adapter/config hashes, and no-retry terminal state. Start the Q1 job with a fail-fast preflight before optimizer work; budget cap <=$0.50 and hard timeout <=30 min. No final bank/panel content and no identity DEV/FINAL prompts in Q1. Current HF auth confirmed @thebrazenbeard, jobs scope, no running jobs, and current OAuth has no write-repos scope: do not add a write token merely to persist a disposable Q1 adapter. If artifact persistence is unavailable under current scopes, Q1 remains receipt/log evidence only and cloud weights are non-promotable. Q2 identity pilot: HOLD until V4.2 V3 role-neutral corpus is adopted, rebuilt, independently audited, token-budget checked, and a baseline retention/capability DEV contract is frozen. For Q2, L4 is probably best information/$; A10G only if maintaining Ampere control is itself part of the question. No paid HF job is authorized by this review; Patrick must approve the spend cap explicitly.
